The '''D3M''' was a speeder manufactured by [[K-NorCo]] and used during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Legacy of the Sith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The K-NorCo D3M was revealed on [[March 10]], [[2026]], as a part of the Continue the Fight bundle alongside game update 7.8.1 "Master's Enigma" as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''.<ref name="Master's Enigma is live">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20260310-0|text=Game Update 7.8.1 "Master's Enigma is live!"}}</ref>
